val.source: Validation, APTOS val + DDR valid (fitting set)

aptos_test.source: APTOS 2019 held-out test (source seen in training)

idrid.source: IDRiD, all 516 graded images (fully external: never trained on or fitted)

ddr.source: DDR test, held out (DDR train used in training)

deepdrid_val.source: DeepDRiD validation, held-out patients (DeepDRiD train used in training)

notes: Research prototype on public datasets; not clinical validation.

v2 graders are trained on APTOS + DDR train + DeepDRiD train; IDRiD is the only fully external test set. DDR test and DeepDRiD val are held out but come from sources seen in training. APTOS split is image-level (no patient IDs).
Public datasets lack age/sex for most images, so patient subgroup analysis was not possible; results are broken down by dataset (camera/site) instead.
PPV/NPV depend on prevalence and do not transfer to PHC populations.
DDR grade 5 (ungradable) images are excluded from grading metrics and used to test the quality gate.

idrid_test.note: 1 DD estimated as true disc-fovea distance / 2.5

pointing_game.dataset: IDRiD segmentation test (n=27), masks dilated 15 px

randomisation.interpretation: low correlation means the map depends on learned weights (passes sanity check)

deepdrid.note: eye label taken from DeepDRiD file names (_l/_r); measured, not assumed

determinism.method: same image analysed twice by the CPU pipeline; result JSON hashed

leakage_check.method: 32x32 normalised-grey image match (RMSE < 0.15) between grading-test images and lesion-model training images
leakage_check.scope: affects only the triage simulation (lesion rules R1a/R5); grader AUROC/sensitivity/specificity are unaffected
